purpose: A POINT-BY-POINT profile from a real pipe: synchronised holdup and pressure time series, which the field sources give outcomes for but not series. This is the artefact item 2 was missing.
source: das Neves, D.A., Vieira, S.C., Cenzi, J.R., Fabro, A.T., Foresti, B.P., Castro, M.S. (2025), 'Dataset of two-phase flow in a horizontal pipe: synchronized measurements of acceleration, pressure, void fraction and high-velocity camera', Data in Brief, doi:10.1016/j.dib.2025.112117. Raw deposit: doi:10.25824/redu/ISMWP4 (UNICAMP Dataverse) with files on the group's Nextcloud share. CC-BY.
facility: Archimede-class horizontal loop, LabPetro/CEPETRO, UNICAMP. Air-water, D = 80.5 mm, horizontal, 23 operating points, 600 s per point.
what_was_retrieved: Dataset_800Hz/Point_1/Data_800Hz_P1.pkl -- 480,800 rows x 28 columns at 799.998 Hz over 601.0 s. Four void-fraction sensors (R1-R4), ten piezoelectric pressure sensors (Pre1-Pre10), five accelerometers, plus per-frame bubble count, diameters, contours, segmentation and tracking.

point_1_conditions.note: from Table 1 of the paper; Point 1 is not among the 14 with quick-closing-valve void fractions.

how_it_was_reached: Recorded because every direct route was blocked and the working one is not obvious. Publisher site returns 403 to automation; the HAL mirror returns access-denied; WebDAV on the share returns 401 under every Basic-auth form. What works: GET the share landing page to obtain a SESSION COOKIE, then call /index.php/s/<token>/download?path=...&files=... with it. A request for a whole folder streams a generated zip with no central directory (so zipfile refuses it, and it cannot be resumed); a request for a SINGLE file returns that file RAW, not zipped. The server also answers 303 for a path that exists and 404 for one that does not, which makes it an existence oracle for filenames -- that is how the Data_<rate>_P<n>.pkl convention was found without a listing.
what_this_CAN_score: Void fraction against the solver's holdup at matched superficial velocities; slug passage frequency from the R-channels against the slug-frequency closure; and fluctuation statistics against predicted slug dynamics.
what_this_CANNOT_score: Absolute pressure or pressure gradient. The Pre channels are PIEZOELECTRIC and AC-coupled: their means sit between -25 and +77 Pa with +/-1-3 kPa excursions, so they measure FLUCTUATION, not level. Mean absolute pressure and pressure gradient exist in the per-point metadata files described in the paper, which are not present in the point folders as published and were not located. A dP comparison still needs those.
limits: Air-water at 80.5 mm, not a hydrocarbon line at 254.5 mm; no hydrate; a lab loop rather than an operator's tie-back. It closes 'no point-by-point profile to score against', not 'no real-line validation'.

SCORED_against_this_solver.status: SCORED. This file was retrieved and then sat unused; 'what_this_CAN_score' listed void fraction and nothing had been. It has now, and it changed a conclusion.
SCORED_against_this_solver.measurement_quality: 601 s at 800 Hz across four sensors; the spread between sensor means is 0.00065, so the mean is precise. This is not a noisy single reading.
SCORED_against_this_solver.what_it_would_take_to_match: With C0 = 1.05 the drift velocity would have to be 1.06 m/s against the closure's 0.48 -- 2.2x Bendiksen. With v_d = 0 it would need C0 = 3.95, which is not a distribution parameter at all. At this condition the closure under-predicts the slip badly.
SCORED_against_this_solver.WHY_THIS_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_ONE_POINT: It sits at Fr 0.41, BELOW the 1.24-4.20 span of the 12 quick-closing-valve points, and it refutes the linear residual model fitted to them. That fit, err = 0.0499*Fr - 0.1246, extrapolates to -0.104 here. The actual error is +0.049 -- wrong sign and wrong by 0.15. The residual is therefore NOT monotone in Froude: it is positive at Fr 0.41, negative through Fr 1.2-2.5, and positive again from Fr 3 to 4.2. A U-shape, not a line.
SCORED_against_this_solver.consequence_for_earlier_claims: This repository had used the linear fit to extrapolate a +0.14 void error at the case-study riser's Fr 5.2. That extrapolation is withdrawn: a linear residual model that fails at one end of the measured range cannot be trusted beyond the other. What stands is that the closure over-predicts void at BOTH extremes of the measured range, and that the riser sits outside it.
